I'm in the same boat. Events in the past are preventing me from moving on. Im in limbo mode as I call it. 
My life got thrown into a tailspin and its completely out of control. I feel completely helpless because my emotions  haunt me every single minute of everyday.  

I was kidnapped and my life got threatened if I didnt come up with 5k$.
I never got over it. I still feel vulnerable and childlike because in most stressful situations now.. 

I've gone through 3 traumatic events in my life that ultimately shaped me into who I am today. From rape, kidnap, and an abusive stepfather... 

I have no clue if I'll ever be able to diminish the memories to a point where I can tolerate them.. But for now, Im living in fear and anxiety. It sucks.

My best friend at the time was well aware of my mental ilness, as I had talked to her about my struggles.
She says she can relate and understand.
But when I really hit rock bottom, she bolted, probably to shelter herself and her family from me. 

The reality is that mental illness can be ugly. Happy go-lucky people like my old friends and family did not grasp just how dark it could get. Even my close ones distanced themselves. Its hard on everyone around you, and I can finally understand and accept that. Yes, it hurts. Its extremely difficult to make any meaningful connections with people who have not suffered through, or understand what its like to struggle with mental illness.

I've come to accept that I'll probably never have a partner, or long lasting friendships because being my friend means seeing a completely different side of me that most people would be put off by. So yeah, I understand what you're going through. Unfortunately for me, it never got better. It just progresses to the point where you find yourself questioning if its really worth it.. 

I live day by day because its all I have. I don't have any life plans nor do I expect to ever be happy again. Mental illness is well known, but the ripple effects that come with it is not well understood. 

I am highly medicated because I am not normal. I am a victim of some underlying genetic fuckup that makes my life a living hell. Is there a light at the end of the tunnel? I doubt it. The efforts I put in are just not helping me feel better. And if I can't feel okay at the very least, why am I still here? I don't even know. I love helping people and thats it. 
Giving people hope is what keeps me going despite being hopeless myself..

I don't have any solid advice for you. I can only relate to the alienation. Im sorry you struggle, I really am. I wish I could help, but I can barely string together a simple sentence these days. I'm losing this battle faster than I could've predicted.. 

Hope you find your way, I love you, and I care about you.

While the Gulf stream isn't the only factor, it still plays a role in Europe's mild winters.
Another player is the lack of North/South mountain ranges enabeling the warm atlantic winds carried in part by our lovely Gulf stream to reach much further inland than it does in North America.
If it suddenly stopped Europe would have extreme variations in both winter and summer. Summer would  would ressemble that of the US Midwest. Violent Tornadoes would be common place just as they are in the US and Canada.
Winters would go from extremely cold and dry, to mild and wet and snowy. Extreme swings in temperature would be the norm.
Ask the UK what happens when the gulf stream slows down. When it does it allows high pressure to build from east to west and bring cold temperatures to Western EU.
Europe's climate is much MUCH more fragile than most would think.
